faqs.1_q: How do I build this book?
faqs.1_a: Through our easy interface, enter your child's details and choose the story theme, and the AI will do the rest in a flash!
faqs.2_q: How long does it take to make and deliver the book?
faqs.2_a: Story generation is instant. Once you approve the order, the book is printed and delivered to you within 5 to 8 business days.
faqs.3_q: Is the book suitable for all ages?
faqs.3_a: Yes! We precisely customize the story's language and style to suit the age group you choose.
faqs.4_q: Can I see the story before buying?
faqs.4_a: Absolutely! You can read our complete sample stories for free, and preview your own child's cover and story before paying and confirming.
faqs.5_q: What materials are used to make the book?
faqs.5_a: We use high-quality paper, color printing, and premium binding to ensure a long-lasting book and a beautiful memory.
faqs.6_q: Do you offer special packages for schools or groups?
faqs.6_a: Absolutely! For schools, kindergartens, and group or bulk orders we offer special pricing and full customization. Get in touch and we'll tailor the perfect package for your group. 🏫

policy.title: Policies and Terms
policy.privacy_content_1: At Magic Fanoos, we take your privacy very seriously. We are committed to protecting your personal data and not sharing it with any third party without your express consent.
policy.privacy_content_2: Data we collect: Name, email, shipping address, and your child's information (name and age) for the purpose of creating the story only.
policy.privacy_content_3: Data Security: All data is encrypted using HTTPS protocol and stored on secure servers.
policy.privacy_content_4: Children's Data: We are committed to special protection for children's data and only use it to create the personalized story.
policy.terms_content_1: Permitted Use: The platform is allowed to be used for personal and family purposes only.
policy.terms_content_2: Intellectual Property: Generated stories are owned by the user after full payment. We reserve the right to use anonymous data to improve the model.
policy.terms_content_3: Content: Using the platform to create offensive or inappropriate content for children is prohibited.
policy.terms_content_4: Pricing: Prices are in Israeli Shekels (₪) and include VAT. We reserve the right to change prices with prior notice.
policy.terms_content_5: Content Protection: All content, trademarks, and designs on this site are private property and protected under intellectual property laws.
policy.terms_content_6: Copyright: Copying, distributing, or reusing any part of the site content without obtaining prior written permission from us is prohibited.
policy.refund_content_1: We operate in accordance with the Israeli Consumer Protection Law of 1981 and the Consumer Protection Regulations (Cancellation of Transaction) of 2010.
policy.refund_content_2: Cancellation within 24 hours: You can cancel your order and get a full refund within the first 24 hours, provided that the production process has not yet started.
policy.refund_content_3: After production starts: The order cannot be cancelled or the amount refunded after printing has started, because the book is customized and printed specifically for you.
policy.refund_content_4: Order error: If you discover an error in the information (such as name or topic) within 24 hours, contact us immediately to make the correction.
policy.refund_content_5: Damage or error from our side: We guarantee to replace the book for free if it arrives damaged or if there was an error in the content from our side.
policy.shipping_content_1: Delivery: We currently ship to all supported areas. Self-pickup is also available.
policy.shipping_content_2: Shipping time: 5-8 business days from the date of payment confirmation.
policy.shipping_content_3: Tracking: You will receive a message with your shipment tracking number as soon as the book is sent.
policy.payment_content_1: Payment methods: We accept payment via credit cards and fully encrypted and approved electronic payment gateways.
policy.payment_content_2: Security: We do not store your credit card data on our servers; all transactions are made through secure and approved payment service providers.
policy.data_deletion_content_1: Your rights: You have the right at any time to request the deletion of your account and all your data or your child's data from our servers.
policy.data_deletion_content_2: Method of request: You can send a data deletion request via email or through the 'Contact Us' page, and the request will be processed and the data permanently erased within a maximum of 14 business days.
policy.footer_question: Do you have questions about our policies?

space.dedication: To [NAME], our brave hero whose dreams and ambitions reach the vast and starry universe.

pages.1: [NAME] always dreamed of the stars. One quiet night, the bed suddenly transformed into a high-tech spaceship filled with glowing buttons!
pages.3: With absolute excitement, [NAME] pressed the big red button, and the spaceship launched like lightning into the deep blue sky.
pages.5: Suddenly, everything in the room floated! In zero gravity, [NAME] drifted in the air like a fish swimming among the stars.
pages.7: [NAME] looked out the large window and saw planet Earth from afar, looking like a beautiful, tiny blue glass marble.
pages.9: The spaceship landed gently on a mysterious planet covered in soft purple sand, with glowing crystals all around.
pages.11: From behind a rock, a small and friendly alien with huge, shiny eyes appeared and began waving warmly at [NAME].
pages.13: The alien couldn't speak, but it drew a large glowing heart in the air, and [NAME] immediately knew it wanted to be a friend.
pages.15: The alien pointed sadly to a deep crater; the planet's power stone had fallen inside, taking away all its light and energy.
pages.17: Without hesitation, [NAME] tied a magical jump rope and bravely climbed down the dark crater to retrieve the stone.
pages.19: When [NAME] returned the stone to its pedestal, the entire planet suddenly lit up with spectacular neon colors and fireworks.
pages.21: To show its gratitude, the alien gifted [NAME] a tiny star that glows in the dark, and then it was time to say goodbye.
pages.23: The spaceship launched once again, carrying the little hero back to Earth through clouds that looked like sweet cotton candy.
pages.25: [NAME] woke up in bed and looked at their hand to find the little star still glowing! [NAME] smiled, knowing that courage reveals the universe's secrets.

school_hero.title: [NAME], The School Hero
school_hero.tagline: A magical adventure about kindness and helping others
school_hero.moral: Kindness is the ultimate superpower, and working together brings color back to our world.
school_hero.conclusion: You are a beacon of light, [NAME]! With your kindness and beautiful spirit, every day is an adventure. 🏫

questions.0: How did [NAME] bring the colors back to school?
questions.1: What did [NAME] do to save the little kitten?
questions.2: How can you also be a hero in your school?

school_hero.dedication: To [NAME], whose pure heart and brilliant smile make school and the world a much brighter place.

pages.1: [NAME] woke up with great energy, put on their favorite backpack, and set off towards school with a bright, happy smile.
pages.3: When [NAME] arrived, they were surprised to find that all the colors had vanished from the school walls! Everything looked sad in black and white.
pages.5: [NAME] did not give up, but decided to discover the secret and use their 'magic pencils' and kindness to bring the school back to life.
pages.7: In the science lab, [NAME] found their friend Sami sad because the volcano experiment failed. With a creative touch, [NAME] helped it erupt in a burst of colors!
pages.9: [NAME] entered the library and heard the books whispering sadly, asking for someone to organize them so their stories could come alive again.
pages.11: [NAME] called their classmates, and together they began organizing the books while singing a happy tune, bringing warmth back to the library.
pages.13: On the playground, [NAME] heard a soft meow; a small, frightened kitten was stuck high up on a tall branch of the school tree.
pages.15: Without hesitation, [NAME] stacked large, colorful blocks to build a safe ladder, gently catching the kitten and returning it to the ground.
pages.17: During recess, [NAME] saw a new student sitting all alone. [NAME] went over to share lunch, proving that kindness is the real superpower.
pages.19: In art class, with the teacher's permission, [NAME] began painting the students' dreams on the walls, and suddenly, vibrant colors returned to the entire school!
pages.21: At the end of the school day, everyone clapped warmly, and the principal presented [NAME] with the 'Little Hero' medal for their courage and kindness.
pages.23: [NAME] ran home excited, proudly telling their mother how school is not just lessons, but a place for adventure and helping others.
pages.25: [NAME] placed the shiny medal next to the bed and closed their eyes, excited and waiting for a brand new school adventure.

toy_city.title: [NAME] and the Hidden Secret of Toy City
toy_city.tagline: Every toy hides a little magic inside
toy_city.moral: When you care for your toys and love them truly, they give back a magic that never runs out.
toy_city.conclusion: Great job, [NAME]! You are now the faithful guardian of your toys, and Tiki's friend forever! 🤖✨
questions: How did [NAME] help Tiki the robot work again?
What did we learn about taking care of our toys?
If you visited magical Toy City, which adventure would you choose first, and why?
toy_city.dedication: To [NAME], who fills our lives with joy and wonder every day — this story is just for you.

pages.1: While [NAME] was tidying the bedroom, a little race car lit up with golden light and opened a magic door that pulled [NAME] straight into Toy City!
pages.3: [NAME] landed gently on a street made of fast racing tracks, where every house was built from colorful building bricks.
pages.5: [NAME] met a small robot named Tiki, who had stopped moving. “I need the Battery of Smiles to work again!” Tiki said in a weak little voice.
pages.7: Tiki pointed to two paths: “Champion, shall we ride the speedy teddy-bear train, or climb the tall tower of bricks? Choose your path wisely, [NAME]!”
pages.9: [NAME] decided to climb the tower of bricks. When it started to wobble, the paper airplanes rushed over and held on tight, so the climb to the top was brave and safe.
pages.11: At the very top [NAME] found the battery — but it was switched off. Remembering Tiki's words, [NAME] gave it a big honest smile, and suddenly the battery lit up in every color!
pages.13: [NAME] ran back and handed the battery to Tiki. The robot leaped for joy, dancing and thanking such a clever friend.
pages.15: Tiki gave [NAME] a tour inside the wonderful toy factory, where ideas turn into real toys. Can you find the little silver key hidden among the machines?
pages.17: [NAME] found a cloth doll, broken and sad, and used clever engineering hands to mend her quietly and kindly.
pages.19: The doll smiled and gave [NAME] the golden Toy Key, which grants the power to care for every toy, always.
pages.21: To celebrate [NAME], the city held a fantastic race — and our hero was the very first driver of a flying car in the sky!
pages.23: Tiki waved goodbye and said: “When you miss us, [NAME], just hug your toys tight, and we will meet again in your dreams!”
pages.25: [NAME] opened both eyes back in the bedroom, still holding the Toy Key. From that day on every toy was cared for well — because each one has a soul and a magic all its own.

magic_book.title: The Journey of the Magic Book

pages.1: In a small room full of toys, [NAME] sat alone, flipping through an old book he had found in the cupboard. Suddenly, the pages began to glow with a strange golden light!
pages.2: "Oh my!" cried [NAME]. The light gently pulled his hand, and in the blink of an eye he was flying inside a swirling vortex of colors and floating words.
pages.3: [NAME] landed softly on a ground made of paper. The trees there were giant crayons, and the sky was painted in bright watercolors.
pages.4: A little rabbit wearing glasses and holding a paintbrush appeared and said: "Welcome, [NAME], to the World of Stories! We have been waiting for you for so long."
pages.5: The rabbit told [NAME] that the "Color of Happiness" had vanished from the book, and the whole world was turning black and white — and only the courage of a real child could bring it back.
pages.6: [NAME] began his journey and reached the "River of Blue Ink," but the bridge was broken. He thought cleverly, picked up a giant pencil, and drew a strong bridge to cross safely.
pages.7: In the dark forest, [NAME] met a wise owl who asked him: "What is the strongest thing in the world?" [NAME] answered: "Imagination!" The owl smiled and handed him a glowing key.
pages.8: [NAME] reached the Mountain of Tales. The path was rough, but he remembered his mother's words about patience and kept climbing until he reached the very top.
pages.9: At the top, [NAME] found an old, locked box. He used the glowing key, and when it opened, thousands of colorful butterflies flew out, coloring everything they touched.
pages.10: The trees turned green and the flowers turned red — the "Color of Happiness" returned to the world, all thanks to [NAME]'s courage.
pages.11: All the characters of the book gathered to celebrate. The rabbit and the owl danced with [NAME] and thanked him for saving their world from disappearing.
pages.12: The rabbit said: "It's time to go home, hero — but always remember, this book is your second home, and your imagination is the key." [NAME] waved goodbye as the golden vortex appeared to carry him back.
pages.13: [NAME] opened his eyes to find himself back in his room, the book in his lap. It no longer glowed, but his heart was full of excitement. He smiled and closed it, knowing his next adventure always lives between the pages of his magic book.

questions.0: What was the strongest thing that helped [NAME] on the journey?
questions.1: What did we learn about courage and patience from [NAME]'s story?
questions.2: If you were [NAME], what would you draw with the magic pencil?

magic_book.moral: Imagination is the strongest power in the world, and courage brings color and joy back to everything.
magic_book.conclusion: You are a real hero, [NAME] — and your imagination is the key to every adventure! ✨
magic_book.dedication: To [NAME], the child who holds a whole world of imagination in their hands.

pirate_adventure.title: [NAME]'s Pirate Treasure Adventure
pirate_adventure.tagline: A thrilling sea voyage in search of hidden treasure
pirate_adventure.moral: The bravest treasure of all is a kind heart, and real adventures are better with friends.
pirate_adventure.conclusion: You're a brave captain, [NAME], and your kind heart is your real treasure! 🏴‍☠️
pirate_adventure.dedication: To [NAME], the little captain who sails toward their dreams with courage and kindness.
questions: What is stronger than gold in the story?
How did [NAME] help the little crab?
If you found a treasure map, where would you sail?

pages.1: One sunny morning, [NAME] found an old bottle on the beach with a treasure map inside! Bursting with excitement, [NAME] decided to become a pirate captain.
pages.2: [NAME] boarded a small wooden ship with a white sail, raised the flag, and set off across the deep blue sea, feeling brave and proud.
pages.3: A colorful, friendly parrot landed on [NAME]'s shoulder, chirping happily — a loyal companion for the whole journey.
pages.4: Suddenly dark clouds gathered and tall waves rocked the ship. [NAME] gripped the wheel tightly and steered bravely straight through the storm.
pages.5: The sea grew calm, and [NAME] reached a mysterious green island with tall palm trees and soft golden sand.
pages.6: A gentle dolphin leaped from the water and, with friendly squeaks, pointed [NAME] toward a hidden path across the island.
pages.7: [NAME] followed the map through the jungle and crossed a wobbly rope bridge over a sparkling river, brave the whole way.
pages.8: At the end of the path, [NAME] found a dark cave guarded by a kind old turtle, who asked a riddle: "What is stronger than gold?"
pages.9: [NAME] thought for a moment, then answered: "A kind heart!" The turtle smiled and opened the cave door.
pages.10: Inside, [NAME] spotted a huge treasure chest — but heard a little crab stuck under a rock, and stopped to free it first.
pages.11: Grateful, the crab showed [NAME] the golden key. [NAME] opened the chest, and it glowed with gold coins and a shiny crown!
pages.12: On the beach, [NAME] celebrated with the parrot, the dolphin, and the crab, sharing the treasure and laughing with joy.
pages.13: As the sun set, [NAME] sailed home wearing the crown and keeping one gold coin — already dreaming of the next great adventure.

dinosaur_adventure.title: [NAME]'s Dinosaur Adventure
dinosaur_adventure.tagline: A wondrous journey into the world before history
dinosaur_adventure.moral: Courage and curiosity open the door to the greatest adventures, and helping others builds the finest friendships.
dinosaur_adventure.conclusion: Well done, [NAME]! You helped a friend and discovered a whole world. 🦕✨
dinosaur_adventure.dedication: To [NAME], who is never afraid of the unknown and loves to discover — this adventure is yours.
questions: Which dinosaur did you like most in the story?
If you were the hero, would you search from the ground or from the sky?
How can we help a friend who has lost something they love?

pages.1: [NAME] was playing in the garden and found a shiny stone as big as an egg. {He|She} touched it… and the ground shook and the garden disappeared!
pages.2: [NAME] opened {his|her} eyes in a strange forest with very tall trees. Then {he|she} heard big footsteps shaking the ground!
pages.3: A huge dinosaur appeared. His name was Trex! But he was kind, not scary. He wore a green scarf and was sadly looking for his lost glasses.
pages.4: "I can't see well without my glasses!" said Trex. [NAME] thought and said: "Hero! Shall we look from the ground on Trex's back, or from the sky with the flying dinosaur?"
pages.5: [NAME] climbed bravely onto Trex's back, and they walked together through the forest, looking everywhere.
pages.6: They came to a blue lake, and [NAME] saw the glasses on top of a tall tree! {He|She} took a long branch and cleverly got them down.
pages.7: Trex put on his glasses and cheered: "Thank you, [NAME]! Now I can see my friends and all the colors again!"
pages.8: Trex took {his|her} friend to a secret cave with old, strange drawings. Hero! Can you find the spotted dinosaur egg among the rocks?
pages.9: The dinosaurs were happy with how clever [NAME] was, and picked {him|her} the biggest strawberry in the world! It was as big as a watermelon and very tasty.
pages.10: [NAME] looked at the faraway mountain and saw a funny volcano puffing colorful soap bubbles instead of fire! {He|She} laughed and laughed.
pages.11: Trex gave [NAME] a little stone with a heart on it, to always remember that {he|she} is a hero and a friend of the dinosaurs.
pages.12: [NAME] closed {his|her} eyes and wished to go home. The trees slowly disappeared, and Trex waved goodbye kindly.
pages.13: [NAME] opened {his|her} eyes in the home garden, with the little stone in {his|her} hand. {He|She} knew that being brave leads to the best adventures!

ocean_adventure.title: [NAME]'s Deep Ocean Adventure
ocean_adventure.tagline: A magical journey into the world beneath the sea
ocean_adventure.moral: Helping a friend works wonders, and the sea is full of life for us to protect.
ocean_adventure.conclusion: Well done, [NAME]! You gave your friend his song back and discovered a whole world. 🐋✨
ocean_adventure.dedication: To [NAME], who loves the sea and dreams of adventures — this story is yours.
questions: Which sea animal did you like most in the story?
If you were the hero, would you search the deep valley or the coral garden?
How can we protect the sea and the friends who live in it?

pages.1: [NAME] was playing on the beach and found a big shiny seashell. {He|She} held it to {his|her} ear… and heard a beautiful song, and a gentle wave pulled {him|her} into the water!
pages.2: [NAME] opened {his|her} eyes under the water — and {he|she} could breathe and talk! All around were colorful fish and coral glowing like lanterns.
pages.3: A huge blue whale came close. His name was Bubble! But he was kind, not scary. He said sadly: "I lost my song, and I can't call my family!"
pages.4: "My song is somewhere in the ocean!" said Bubble. [NAME] thought and said: "Hero! Shall we search the deep dark valley, or ride the fast current to the coral garden?"
pages.5: [NAME] climbed bravely onto Bubble's back, and they swam together among the fish, with bubbles dancing all around them.
pages.6: They reached the coral garden, and [NAME] saw a golden shell inside a narrow cave. {He|She} went in quietly and cleverly brought it out.
pages.7: Bubble opened his mouth and sang! His song came back, and he cried happily: "Thank you, [NAME]! Now my family can hear me!"
pages.8: Bubble took {his|her} friend to a cave full of colorful coral and shining pearls. Hero! Can you find the little seahorse hiding in the coral?
pages.9: The fish were so happy with how clever [NAME] was. They danced around {him|her} and gave {him|her} the biggest pearl in the sea!
pages.10: [NAME] looked up and saw big sea turtles gliding slowly through the sunbeams, and jellyfish glowing like stars.
pages.11: Bubble gave [NAME] a little singing seashell, to always remember that {he|she} is a hero and a friend of the sea.
pages.12: [NAME] closed {his|her} eyes and wished to go back to the beach. {He|She} floated up slowly with the bubbles, while Bubble said goodbye with a beautiful song.
pages.13: [NAME] opened {his|her} eyes on the beach, with the little shell in {his|her} hand. {He|She} knew that helping friends makes the best adventures!

world_adventure.title: [NAME]'s Adventure Around the World
world_adventure.tagline: A magical trip around the world in a single day
world_adventure.moral: An open mind and a loving heart turn the whole world into a home full of friends.
world_adventure.conclusion: Wonderful, [NAME]! You travelled all the way around the world and came home carrying the friendship of every child in it. 🌍✨
questions: Which country in the story did you like best, and why?
If you were the hero, would you ride the balloon or head into the Amazon?
What word would you most like to learn in a new language?
world_adventure.dedication: To [NAME], who dreams of travelling and loves meeting new people — this story is just for you.

pages.1: While [NAME] was spinning an old globe in the bedroom, the map of the world lit up with bright golden light and opened a magic doorway that pulled [NAME] away to the very first stop!
pages.2: [NAME] landed high on the Great Wall of China, green mountains rolling away on every side, welcomed by children flying a long, colorful paper dragon kite.
pages.3: With one magical touch [NAME] arrived on the golden sand in front of the great pyramids of Giza, and met a friendly camel named Mishmish.
pages.4: Mishmish pointed down two paths: “Champion! Shall we ride the colorful hot-air balloon over the Eiffel Tower in Paris, or dive into the green Amazon rainforest?” Choose your way wisely, [NAME]!
pages.5: [NAME] chose the colorful balloon, floating high above Paris and looking down on the soaring Eiffel Tower as it glinted in the sunshine.
pages.6: The balloon set down gently in the thick Amazon rainforest, where [NAME] met bright parrots and butterflies as big as the palm of a hand, walking along the path together.
pages.7: The weather turned suddenly, bitterly cold, and [NAME] arrived at the Arctic in a warm coat, playing with polar bears under a sky of green and violet lights.
pages.8: [NAME] reached a sunny beach in Japan lined with pink sakura trees. Champion! Can you find the little golden compass hidden among the shells on the sand?
pages.9: In every country [NAME] visited, there was a new word to learn: “thank you”, “hello”, and “I love you” — and the discovery that every child in the world understands a smile.
pages.10: [NAME] gathered treasures into a bag: a bright feather from the Amazon, a small stone from the pyramids, and a sakura blossom from Japan, to remember this great journey.
pages.11: For all the beauty of every country in the world, [NAME] began to miss home and family, and remembered that the loveliest place of all is the place you come from.
pages.12: [NAME] closed both eyes and the globe turned slowly, carrying the journey gently back to that quiet bedroom.
pages.13: [NAME] opened both eyes and looked at the map of the world on the wall, knowing that an open mind and a loving heart make you a friend to every child on earth.

deep_sea.title: [NAME]'s Adventure in the Deep Sea
deep_sea.tagline: A ride in a glass submarine to bring back the ocean's light
deep_sea.moral: Keeping nature clean and protecting the creatures in it is the job of every real hero.
deep_sea.conclusion: Wonderful, [NAME]! You brought the light back to the deep and became a protector of the sea. 🐬✨
questions: What did the hero do to keep the sea clean?
If it were you, would you ride the fast dolphin or go with the wise turtle?
How can we help the sea and its creatures in everyday life?
deep_sea.dedication: To [NAME], who loves the sea and looks after every creature in it — this story is just for you.

pages.1: While [NAME] was playing on the beach, a blue shell caught the light in the sand. The moment it was held to an ear, a small glass submarine appeared, calling [NAME] away on a voyage of discovery!
pages.2: [NAME] dived down in the submarine into the deep ocean, past colorful coral reefs and fish that glowed like tiny lanterns.
pages.3: There [NAME] met a dolphin named Bobo, who explained that the Shining Pearl — the one that lights the whole ocean at night — had vanished beneath the rocks.
pages.4: Bobo said: “Champion! Shall we ride the fast dolphin straight through the currents, or go with the wise turtle who knows the safe way?” Choose your path wisely, [NAME]!
pages.5: [NAME] chose to go with the wise turtle, who led the way through a beautiful valley of coral and taught [NAME] how to swim slowly and calmly.
pages.6: They reached the pearl, wedged tight between the rocks. [NAME] worked the submarine's robotic arm cleverly and carefully, easing the pearl free without harming a single living thing.
pages.7: [NAME] set the pearl back where it belonged, and all at once the whole deep lit up in blue and pink — the loveliest sight in the ocean!
pages.8: The sea creatures threw a colorful celebration to thank [NAME] for being clever and brave. Champion! Can you find the glowing pink shell hidden among the coral?
pages.9: [NAME] helped the little fish gather the plastic bags tangled in the coral, so their home in the water would stay clean.
pages.10: [NAME] learned how to talk with the dolphins and whales, through signs and soft musical sounds.
pages.11: The king of the seas gave [NAME] a bright shell necklace, a reminder of being a friend to the ocean and a guardian of everything living in it.
pages.12: The glass submarine floated gently up toward the surface, and the rush of the water slowly grew quiet.
pages.13: [NAME] opened both eyes sitting on the sand of the beach, the blue shell resting alongside, knowing that keeping nature clean is the job of every real hero.

little_chef.title: [NAME] the Little Chef
little_chef.tagline: One morning in the kitchen makes a little hero
little_chef.moral: Care, cleanliness and trying it yourself are the secret behind every job done well.
little_chef.conclusion: Well done, [NAME]! You became the little chef and the best helper in the house. 🍳✨
questions: What is the first thing we do before we start cooking?
If you were the hero, would you wash the tomatoes first or cut the lettuce?
Which dish would you most like to make with your family?
little_chef.dedication: To [NAME], who loves to help and to try things alone — this story is just for you.

pages.1: On a bright morning of a day off, [NAME] decided to help Mum in the kitchen and make lunch for the family — apron on, bouncing with excitement.
pages.2: [NAME] washed both hands thoroughly with soap and water, then laid out the clean tools neatly on a low table.
pages.3: [NAME] opened the simple recipe book and chose to make a crunchy vegetable salad with a tasty grilled chicken sandwich.
pages.4: Out came the vegetables from the fridge: “Champion! Shall we start by washing the red tomatoes and the cucumber, or by cutting the fresh green lettuce leaves?” Choose your first step wisely, [NAME]!
pages.5: [NAME] began washing the vegetables carefully under cold water, making sure they were clean and safe for everyone to eat.
pages.6: With a child-safe plastic knife and Mum watching close by, [NAME] sliced the cucumber into even rounds and the tomatoes into small pieces, careful and focused.
pages.7: The vegetables went into a big bowl, then a light pinch of salt, a few drops of olive oil and fresh lemon juice — all folded together gently.
pages.8: Time to lay the table and arrange the plates beautifully, to make the whole family hungry. Champion! Can you find the wooden spoon hidden behind the fruit bowl?
pages.9: [NAME] set out the plates, the spoons and the napkins on the dining table, neat and lovely.
pages.10: [NAME] carried in the salad and the sandwiches and served them to Mum and Dad, smiling with pride and wishing them a delicious meal.
pages.11: When everyone tasted the food, they praised how good it was and how carefully it had been made. [NAME] learned that the secret of tasty food is care, cleanliness, and doing it yourself.
pages.12: [NAME]'s job did not end at eating: there was the table to wipe and the splashes of water to clear, so the kitchen stayed spotless.
pages.13: [NAME] dried both hands and felt proud and content — now the little chef and the first helper in the house.

little_engineer.title: [NAME]'s Adventure in Building and Engineering
little_engineer.tagline: A plan, a toolbox, and a treehouse for the little friends
little_engineer.moral: With a plan, tidy habits and safe work, the best ideas become real.
little_engineer.conclusion: Well done, [NAME]! You built a house for the little friends with your own hands. 🛠️✨
questions: Why do we need a plan before we start building?
If you were the hero, would you start with the posts or with the floor?
What would you build if you had your own toolbox?
little_engineer.dedication: To [NAME], who loves to build and to plan things out — this story is just for you.

pages.1: [NAME] sat in the bedroom in a little engineer's helmet, going over a drawing made from scratch — a plan for a wonderful treehouse for the small animals in the garden.
pages.2: [NAME] opened a safe little toolbox and laid everything out in order: the measuring tape, the spirit level and the wooden blocks, all ready for work to begin.
pages.3: [NAME] went out into the garden and laid the light timber on level ground, to build the base of the house.
pages.4: [NAME] stood and thought it over: “Champion! Shall we put up the four wooden posts first to raise the house, or lay the colorful floor?” Choose your step wisely, [NAME]!
pages.5: [NAME] chose the posts first, fixing the timber carefully and using the spirit level to check that every post stood perfectly straight.
pages.6: [NAME] designed a safe triangular roof to keep the rain and the sun out, and painted it a beautiful blue.
pages.7: [NAME] fitted a small door and smooth handles, so getting into the treehouse would be easy and safe for every bird and squirrel friend.
pages.8: Time to paint the wooden house in bright colors and decorate the doorway with flowers. Champion! Can you find the orange tool belt hidden behind the tree?
pages.9: [NAME] checked the work calmly, resting a light weight on top to be sure it was strong and steady before the little residents moved in.
pages.10: The squirrels and the birds came to visit the new treehouse, went inside, and were delighted with its warm, comfortable little rooms.
pages.11: Mum gave [NAME] a “Little Engineer” badge, for such careful work, such a fine plan, and a build that was safe as well as beautiful.
pages.12: With the work finished, [NAME] cleaned the site, collected every tool and put it back in its box, so the place stayed safe and tidy.
pages.13: [NAME] looked up at the treehouse and felt proud, understanding that with a plan and steady work, the loveliest ideas can be built for real.

castle_guardian.title: [NAME] and the Guardian of the Old Castle
castle_guardian.tagline: An ancient castle, a puzzle, and a History Guardian badge
castle_guardian.moral: Knowing history and protecting old places gives us wisdom and courage.
castle_guardian.conclusion: Well done, [NAME]! You are the little Guardian of History now. 🏰✨
questions: Why do we look after ancient things?
If you were the hero, would you climb the tower or visit the hall of shields?
What is the best thing you have ever seen in a museum?
castle_guardian.dedication: To [NAME], who loves old stories and asks about everything — this story is just for you.

pages.1: [NAME] was reading a picture book about old castles and knights, and decided to visit the history museum with the family.
pages.2: [NAME] stepped into the ancient castle, with its high stone walls and towers reaching up toward the sky.
pages.3: There [NAME] met the head guide, who handed over a map for the hunt for the Shield of Courage and Honour.
pages.4: [NAME] stopped where the stairway split in two: “Champion! Shall we climb up to the high watchtower, or explore the hall of shields and medals?” Choose your way wisely!
pages.5: [NAME] chose the hall, wandering among the old treasures and reading every label with real interest.
pages.6: There stood an old wooden box, locked behind a puzzle: numbers to be added up into the right date.
pages.7: [NAME] used clever thinking, adding the years written on the labels, and the box opened quietly.
pages.8: Inside lay the castle keepsake shield, made of gleaming copper. Champion! Can you find the old brass key hidden beside the shield?
pages.9: The guide pinned on the “Little Guardian of History” badge, for such curiosity and such careful listening.
pages.10: [NAME] posed for photographs beside the great stone walls, holding the badge with pride.
pages.11: [NAME] learned why we protect old places and never touch or damage them, so their story stays for everyone.
pages.12: Back home, [NAME] set the castle badge in the special corner of treasures in the bedroom.
pages.13: [NAME] sat writing down everything learned that day, knowing that history gives you the wisdom and the courage to build the future.

happy_kindergarten.title: [NAME]'s Day at the Happy Kindergarten
happy_kindergarten.tagline: Colours, stories and brand new friends
happy_kindergarten.moral: Sharing, kindness and tidying up make every day better.
happy_kindergarten.conclusion: Well done, [NAME]! You are the kind little hero of the kindergarten. 🧸✨
questions: Which corner would you most like to play in?
If you were the hero, would you choose the blocks or the colouring?
How can we be kind friends to the children around us?
happy_kindergarten.dedication: To [NAME], who takes the very first step with courage and a smile — this story is just for you.

pages.1: [NAME] woke up with a wide smile, put on comfy colourful clothes, and got ready for kindergarten carrying a little backpack.
pages.2: [NAME] walked into the warm kindergarten rooms, full of toys, bright pictures on the walls and colourful wooden blocks.
pages.3: The teacher welcomed [NAME] with a gentle smile, helped hang up the bag and wrote [NAME] on a cubby of their very own.
pages.4: The other children pointed around the room: “Champion! Shall we play in the blocks and playdough corner, or go to the colouring and stories corner?” Choose your activity wisely, [NAME]!
pages.5: [NAME] chose the colouring corner, picked up the wax crayons and drew a laughing sun above a green garden.
pages.6: [NAME] sat with the other children in a soft circle, listening to the teacher tell a lovely story about kind animals.
pages.7: [NAME] shared toys with a new friend, and learned that sharing makes playing far more fun.
pages.8: Time for free play in the kindergarten yard, full of things to climb and ride. Champion! Can you find the little yellow star hidden behind the toy box?
pages.9: [NAME] opened the lunchbox and ate two pieces of fruit and drank water, happy and tidy.
pages.10: [NAME] sang the numbers and letters song with everyone, hands waving along to the rhythm.
pages.11: When playtime ended, [NAME] hurried to put every toy back in its right place, so the kindergarten stayed neat.
pages.12: The teacher pinned a “Kind Hero” badge on [NAME], for being so tidy and so gentle with the other children.
pages.13: [NAME] went home hugging the badge and telling the family all about the new friends, already looking forward to tomorrow.

first_day_school.title: [NAME]'s First Day at School
first_day_school.tagline: A new bag, new friends, and a day to remember
first_day_school.moral: Being brave on the first step opens the door to friendship and learning.
first_day_school.conclusion: Well done, [NAME]! You are the star of the very first day. 🎒✨
questions: What makes you happiest about a first day at school?
If you were the hero, would you go to the play corner or the school garden?
How can we welcome a new friend into our class?
first_day_school.dedication: To [NAME], who walks through the school gate for the first time with a brave heart — this story is just for you.

pages.1: [NAME] woke early with a heart full of excitement, put on the new school uniform and packed everything neatly into a bright new bag.
pages.2: [NAME] walked to school with Mum and Dad, past cheerful painted walls and a wide yard welcoming children with smiles.
pages.3: [NAME] stepped into the school yard, where the teacher gave a warm smile and welcomed [NAME] and all the new friends kindly.
pages.4: The teacher pointed around the yard: “Champion! Shall we explore the games and activities corner first, or walk through the school garden?” Choose your step wisely!
pages.5: [NAME] chose the play corner, and built a tall tower of coloured blocks together with the new friends, all helping.
pages.6: The school bell rang, and [NAME] lined up neatly with the class for morning exercises and the school song.
pages.7: [NAME] walked toward the classroom with confident steps, excited to discover what came next.
pages.8: Break time, and a chance to explore the school. Champion! Can you find the little golden pencil hidden behind the school bag?
pages.9: [NAME] helped a classmate carry their things, and that was the first real friendship of the year.
pages.10: [NAME] sat with the new friends over a crunchy healthy snack and a cool drink, everyone laughing together.
pages.11: The teacher praised how brave and how tidy [NAME] had been, and gave out an “Active Star” sticker for the first day.
pages.12: [NAME] went home happy and full of talk about the first adventure and all the new friends.
pages.13: [NAME] fell asleep still wearing the sticker, certain now that school is a second home, full of learning and friendship.

first_grade.title: [NAME] in First Grade
first_grade.tagline: Letters, words, and a first sentence read out loud
first_grade.moral: With focus and effort, reading and writing become easier and far more fun.
first_grade.conclusion: Well done, [NAME]! You read your very first sentence out loud. ✏️✨
questions: What was the first letter you learned?
If you were the hero, would you choose the word cards or the colouring?
What lovely word would you most like to write?
first_grade.dedication: To [NAME], who learns a letter a day with patience and joy — this story is just for you.

pages.1: [NAME] sat at a comfortable desk in the first grade classroom, looking at the board and all the colourful things around the room.
pages.2: [NAME] opened a clean white notebook, held the pencil steadily and lined up the colours ready for the writing and drawing lesson.
pages.3: The teacher wrote the first letter on the board, and [NAME] began to read it aloud, clear and careful, with everyone cheering.
pages.4: The teacher said: “First grade champion! Shall we solve the word-card puzzle, or colour the glowing alphabet chart?” Choose your step wisely!
pages.5: [NAME] chose the word cards, calmly arranging letters to build simple words about school and the world outside.
pages.6: Faced with a simple sum, [NAME] used the little counting blocks and worked out the right answer alone.
pages.7: [NAME] stood up with confidence and read a first whole sentence out clearly, to the teacher’s delight and the class’s applause.
pages.8: Free activity time in the classroom, tidying the corners. Champion! Can you find the little orange block hidden behind the class bookshelf?
pages.9: [NAME] helped push in the chairs and gather the pencils after the lesson, so the classroom stayed neat.
pages.10: The teacher put [NAME]’s name up on the first grade Excellence Board.
pages.11: [NAME] shared a favourite story with the other children in the quiet reading corner.
pages.12: [NAME] packed everything neatly into the school bag, feeling proud and grown up.
pages.13: [NAME] went home telling Mum and Dad how reading and writing had become easier and much more fun, thanks to paying attention and trying hard.

future_hero.title: [NAME], Hero of the Future
future_hero.tagline: Many jobs to try, and one big dream
future_hero.moral: Every job needs honesty, learning, and a love of helping other people.
future_hero.conclusion: Well done, [NAME]! You are the hero of the future. 🚀✨
questions: What would you like to be when you grow up?
If you were the hero, would you try engineering or medicine?
How can you help people today, while you are still small?
future_hero.dedication: To [NAME], who dreams big and starts working on it today — this story is just for you.

pages.1: [NAME] sat in the bedroom leafing through a picture magazine full of people at work, and wondered with a smile: “What will I be when I grow up?”
pages.2: [NAME] opened the toy box and tried on all sorts of things: an engineer’s hard hat, a doctor’s stethoscope, and an astronaut’s suit!
pages.3: [NAME] imagined standing in a clever laboratory full of screens and modern tools, for helping people and solving problems.
pages.4: [NAME] looked at the choices: “Champion! Shall we take the engineer and coding tour and build smart cities, or the kind doctor tour and look after people’s health?” Choose your path wisely!
pages.5: [NAME] tried being a little engineer, drawing a careful plan for a green city that runs on sunshine to protect the environment.
pages.6: Then came the kind doctor, using a stethoscope to check that friends were well and telling everyone about healthy food and clean hands.
pages.7: [NAME] discovered that whichever job you choose, it needs honesty, learning, and a love of helping others.
pages.8: [NAME] visited a hands-on careers exhibition, learning what each person does to build a community. Champion! Can you find the golden star of the future hidden behind the display stand?
pages.9: [NAME] also tried being a clever teacher, patiently showing other children how to explore and think things through.
pages.10: [NAME] learned that the road to the future starts today, with learning, effort and good habits.
pages.11: The teacher gave [NAME] a “Hero of the Future” badge, a reminder of being able to reach any goal at all.
pages.12: [NAME] set the badge on the desk and picked up a pencil to study hard, because the future is built today.
pages.13: [NAME] closed both eyes with pride and confidence, knowing that with focus and passion there is a great part to play in the future.

ramadan_first.title: [NAME]'s First Ramadan
ramadan_first.tagline: A crescent, a lantern, and a heart learning to give
ramadan_first.moral: Fasting is patience and giving is light — and the best thing about Ramadan is that we grow a little inside it.
ramadan_first.conclusion: Well done, [NAME]! You fasted, you shared, you gave — Eid Mubarak. 🌙🏮
ramadan_first.dedication: For [NAME], who waits for Ramadan every year — this story is for you.
questions: What do we break the fast with when the call to prayer sounds?
Why did patience get easier once the hero went out to play?
Who is the musaharati, and what does he do?
What is something you would like to share with your neighbours?

pages.1: On a quiet evening, [NAME] stood on the rooftop with the family, searching the sky for the crescent of Ramadan. And suddenly — there it was, thin and silver, like a smile!
pages.2: [NAME] hung the golden lantern on the balcony, and its warm light filled the whole house. “Ramadan Kareem!”
pages.3: In the kitchen, [NAME] helped Mum arrange the plate of dates and the jug of water on the iftar table, carefully and proudly.
pages.4: In the morning [NAME] decided to try fasting for the very first time — the little “sparrows’ fast” — until noon.
pages.5: By midday the thirst came. Little hero! On the RIGHT, a cold glass of juice. On the LEFT, a door leading out to play with friends. Which will you choose?
pages.6: [NAME] chose to play, and the time flew by, and the thirst was forgotten. Patience is easier when we fill the day with good things.
pages.7: [NAME] visited Grandma and read her a page, and Grandma smiled and said, “Your voice lights up this house.”
pages.8: Before sunset, [NAME] carried a plate of food to the neighbours. Sharing makes food taste better.
pages.9: And at last — the call to prayer! [NAME] broke the fast with a single date and a sip of water, the most delicious date in all the world.
pages.10: After iftar, [NAME] walked with the family down a street strung with lanterns, the lights dancing overhead.
pages.11: That night [NAME] heard the drum of the musaharati: “Wake, O sleeper!” And up [NAME] got, for suhoor with the family.
pages.12: [NAME] gathered toys and coins into a small box and gave them to other children. Giving lights up the heart like a lantern.
pages.13: And on the morning of Eid, [NAME] put on new Eid clothes and was given the eidiyah and the warmest hug. “Eid Mubarak, [NAME]!”

eid_first.title: [NAME]'s First Eid
eid_first.tagline: New clothes, an eidiyah, and a joy worth dividing
eid_first.moral: Eid is not only new clothes — Eid is making the people around us happy.
eid_first.conclusion: Eid Mubarak, [NAME]! You shared your joy, and it grew. 🌙🎁
eid_first.dedication: For [NAME], who knows the best gift is the one we give — this story is for you.
questions: What do we say to people on the morning of Eid?
Why did the joy grow bigger when the hero shared the eidiyah?
What is the nicest thing you have done on Eid?
Who would you like to make happy next Eid?

pages.1: On the night before Eid, [NAME] heard the takbeer drifting from the mosque, laid the new Eid clothes beside the bed, and fell asleep full of waiting.
pages.2: Early in the morning [NAME] woke before everyone, put on the new Eid clothes and a little perfume. Today is Eid!
pages.3: [NAME] went with the family to the Eid prayer, through streets full of people and decorations and smiles.
pages.4: After the prayer [NAME] hugged everyone and said, “Eid Mubarak!” — and their heart filled right up with joy.
pages.5: Grandfather gave [NAME] the eidiyah in a small envelope, and [NAME] thanked him with the widest smile.
pages.6: Little hero! On the RIGHT, a sweet shop full of colours. On the LEFT, a friend who received no eidiyah at all. Which will you choose?
pages.7: [NAME] chose to share, and bought a small gift for the friend. Joy grows bigger when we divide it.
pages.8: At Grandma's, [NAME] helped arrange the tray of kaak and maamoul, and tasted the first warm piece.
pages.9: In the Eid square [NAME] rode the swing, and the laughter rose over the whole square.
pages.10: Little hero! Can you see the big RED BALLOON right in front of the swing?
pages.11: [NAME] handed out sweets to the children of the neighbourhood, and small hands reached out with joy and thanks.
pages.12: In the evening the family took a photograph together, with [NAME] in the middle holding the very same lantern from Ramadan.
pages.13: Before bed [NAME] put the eidiyah in its box and smiled: “The best day of the year — and we'll wait for the next Eid together.”

big_brother.title: [NAME] Becomes a Big {Brother|Sister}
big_brother.tagline: A small heart making room for a new love
big_brother.moral: Love does not get divided when someone new arrives — it grows.
big_brother.conclusion: Well done, [NAME]! You became a kind big one. 👶💙
big_brother.dedication: For [NAME], who welcomed someone new with a big heart — this story is for you.
questions: How did the hero feel when they heard the news?
How did the hero calm the baby when he cried?
What would you like to teach your little brother or sister?
What do you do to help your mum at home?

pages.1: [NAME]’s mum sat down and said with a smile: “I have lovely news… you’re going to have a little brother!” And [NAME]’s eyes went wide with surprise and joy.
pages.2: That night [NAME] thought quietly: “Will they still love me the same?” — and hugged the little teddy bear tight.
pages.3: [NAME] helped get the baby’s room ready, and hung paper stars above the tiny cot.
pages.4: At the shop, [NAME] chose a present for the baby: two tiny socks the colour of the sky.
pages.5: Little hero! On the RIGHT, keep the favourite teddy. On the LEFT, give it to the baby. Which will you choose?
pages.6: [NAME] laid the teddy in the baby’s cot and said, “I’ll teach him how to play with it.”
pages.7: The day came! [NAME] waited at Grandma’s, counting the minutes with a thumping heart.
pages.8: And at last… [NAME] saw the little brother for the very first time. So small — his fingers tinier than a button!
pages.9: The baby cried, so [NAME] sang him a quiet song… and he hushed and fell asleep. “I know how to calm him!”
pages.10: [NAME] fetched the nappy and the towel, and became Mum’s number one helper.
pages.11: Little hero! Can you see the tiny BLUE SOCK right in front of the cot?
pages.12: Mum hugged [NAME] and said: “My heart is big enough for both of you. You are the big one now.”
pages.13: Before bed, [NAME] whispered to the baby: “I’ll teach you everything… and I’ll always keep you safe.”
